rationale: The workflow is a single lint job triggered on pull_requests to main, so newer commits on the same PR supersede earlier runs. Adding a concurrency group scoped by workflow and ref (refs/pull/N/merge) with cancel-in-progress implements P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs): when a new commit lands on a PR, the stale in-progress lint run is canceled while the latest revision still runs the full lint check, preserving coverage. Preconditions are verifiable from the repository files: runs represent the same workflow and branch/PR, and this is lint-only (not release/deployment work), with distinct PRs using distinct refs so branches do not share a cancellation group. Permissions are left unchanged (contents: write), no new actions/secrets/publishing/deployment/network access are added, and all existing steps are preserved.
